candidate.description: Which candidate from discover_applications. Defaults to 1.

deployment.description: How the application is deployed, as the person describes it. Leave a question out when unsure; discovery finds it.

env_location.description: Whether env_path is on the server or inside the container.

env_path.description: The .env file to keep versions of.

file_roots.description: Folders the Files tab may open.

folder.description: The application's folder on the server, such as /srv/shop.

anchor_at.description: When the first run happens, with its UTC offset; later runs keep its beat.

interval_minutes.description: Run every this many minutes; null runs only when asked.

keep.description: How many to keep here, 1 to 5.

keep_remote.description: How many to keep on the server, 0 to 5.

paths.description: Folders to archive, or the folder to collect from.

time_zone.description: The time zone whose clock a daily plan keeps, as Europe/Berlin.

confirmation.description: The id fingerprint_host returned, once a person confirmed the fingerprint.

key_file.description: A private key file path here.

path.description: An absolute path on the server.
